overall_limitations: Independent computational review, not independent experimental replication.
No discovery or state changes performed.
Authoritative source semantics relied on preserved protocol/source audit; reproduction does not independently validate clock synchronization.

reliability.rationale: Native reconstruction exactly matches60 confirmation trials;11 frozen predictors and group-MAE values independently replayed. All freeze hashes match.

mechanism.rationale: The audited code uses contemporaneous achieved throughput and empirical offered-rate cells. This does not isolate packet loss, radio-only latency or physical service capacity.

novelty.rationale: Computational review does not conduct independent literature novelty adjudication; source queue/load analyses already disclosed.

significance.rationale: The matched-control and ablation failures are useful benchmark evidence; practical value is bounded to these offered-load settings.

reproducibility.rationale: Verified native-to-prepared identities, targets and predictors; all11 model predictions reproduce in an isolated package without research-history imports.

impact.rationale: No deployment intervention, energy saving, service-level improvement or independent network test is provided.

checks: Source hashes verified and excluded clock-wrap records retained as ineligible.
Whole-location partitions disjoint; fitted states use five development locations.
Only declared same-run offered/achieved rates enter prediction.
Reference loses to RBF overall; throughput-correction ablation worsens confirmation.
limitations: Two heldout locations in one installation do not support population confidence.
Same-run achieved throughput is a declared diagnostic input, not prospective offered-load information.
Standalone CLI manifest was supplied in the disposable copy because root sealing is pending; numerical replay itself passed.
